recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the published Pharmacy decision by removing remaining active narrative that could still lead implementers to model substance abuse or non-prescribed alcohol/tobacco use as MedicationStatement instead of Observation.
issue_request: FHIR-39165 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked how to record tobacco or alcohol in MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement when those agents are not medications and MedicationUsage.medication/MedicationStatement.medication is mandatory; the resolution removed substance-abuse use from scope, directed non-prescribed alcohol/tobacco use to Observation, and allowed prescribed agents such as nicotine replacement or long term care alcohol in MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement.
initial_application: Commit ccd70e13dace3a42cdffade3560070c4ef2af900 applied FHIR-39165 by replacing the explicit paragraph allowing substance abuse/tobacco/alcohol with a SHALL NOT/UNLESS-prescribed paragraph. It did not update adjacent scope and boundary text that still described common use as recording recreational drugs and said the resource recorded medications or substances.
additional_context: FHIR-38682 changed the R5 ballot resource name back from MedicationUsage to MedicationStatement without changing the relevant scope, explaining the artifact name mismatch. source/fhir.ini lists MedicationStatement as an active approved Pharmacy resource. Confluence minutes from 2022-11-07 record discussion of FHIR-39165 but no conclusion; later Jira publication is the controlling decision. FHIR-39583 was applied in the same historical commit but concerns renderedDosageInstruction markdown and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml to say common usage includes non-prescription medications rather than recreational drugs, to clarify that non-prescribed tobacco/alcohol use should be Social History Observations while preserving the prescribed-agent exception, and to remove generic substances from the Boundaries description of what MedicationStatement records.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: changed the common-use bullet from non-prescription/recreational drugs to non-prescription medications.

source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: rewrote the FHIR-39165 paragraph to clearly direct non-prescribed alcohol/tobacco uses to Social History Observations and preserve the prescribed-agent exception.
source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: changed the Boundaries description from recording medications or substances to recording medications.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement, explaining why the Jira uses MedicationUsage while current source uses MedicationStatement.
Applied in the same historical commit as FHIR-39165 but concerned renderedDosageInstruction markdown, not the alcohol/tobacco scope boundary.
